- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided advice on preparing fabric for stamping, including choosing the right fabric (natural fibers, loose weaves, thicker fabrics), washing and drying the fabric, ironing it, stretching and stabilizing it, and applying a resist.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended using acrylic paint or ink specifically designed for fabric stamping and provided tips for applying paint evenly, pressing firmly, and experimenting with pressure and angle.
- [PREFERENCE] The user mentioned they found a vintage scarf at a thrift store and considered using it for fabric stamping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that a vintage scarf would work well for fabric stamping and suggested cleaning it, handling it delicately, and considering its texture and pattern.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised cutting the scarf into a manageable size and shape and optionally applying a thin layer of gesso or modeling paste for a more defined stamp.
